summary: Backend e2e testing complete for FORM CaseCraft. All 16 pytest tests passed (100%). Validated health, seeded data (7 brands, 4 products, models per brand), auth (JWT + httpOnly cookie + 401 without token), file uploads with static serving via /api/uploads, complete order lifecycle (create→retrieve→payment-proof→admin approval), admin analytics, settings GET/PUT, and brand→model cascade delete.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Should use explicit origins from env (e.g., REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/frontend origin) instead of wildcard.
No brute-force lockout — login accepts unlimited failed attempts. Playbook expected 5-fail lockout.
No server-side validation that brand_id/model_id/product_id exist, no amount cross-check against product price (client supplies amount), enabling price tampering.
Public endpoint — anyone with an order_id can overwrite UTR/screenshot. Should be rate-limited or scoped to original session.
Unauthenticated and accepts up to 12MB; no rate-limit or per-IP throttling → DoS / storage abuse risk.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager.

action_items: Tighten CORS: replace allow_origins=['*'] with explicit frontend origin when allow_credentials=True.
Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (e.g., 5 failures → temporary lock).
Validate brand/model/product existence and recompute amount server-side in POST /api/orders.
Protect/limit payment-proof submission and file uploads (size already capped at 12MB; add rate limiting + auth where applicable).
Migrate startup/shutdown to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: bcrypt hashing format verified ($2b$) via successful login round-trip.
httpOnly cookie 'access_token' is set with secure=True, samesite=none — works behind https ingress; confirmed present in Set-Cookie.
seed_admin re-hashes password if env ADMIN_PASSWORD differs from stored hash — idempotent and correct.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection ({'_id': 0}) — good.
Order ID generator uses FRM-YYMMDD-HEX(6) format — matches spec.
Static uploads correctly mounted under /api/uploads so Kubernetes ingress routes them to backend.
CORS misconfiguration (wildcard + credentials) is the most important issue to fix.
